items.text: New England QB: Drake Maye (fractured fibula) expected out at least six weeks; Vrabel: 'Tommy's our starter.' Tommy DeVito starts.
New England (early week): WR A.J. Brown (hamstring) out multiple weeks. IR - WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder), RB TreVeyon Henderson. G Alijah Vera-Tucker returned to practice.

LA Chargers QB (uncertain): Justin Herbert in concussion protocol after Wk11; DJ Uiagalelei next up, Jake Browning promoted. Also monitoring RB Keaton Mitchell (knee), EDGE Akheem Mesidor (ankle); LB Daiyan Henley, CB Tarheeb Still missed Wk11.

adjust.reason: New England is without its top receivers A.J. Brown and Romeo Doubs plus RB Henderson, outweighing the Chargers' defensive questions (Henley, Still, Mesidor). The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
